publicationUrls.title: Publication URLs or handles
publicationUrls.description: Substack publications to scrape. Accepts any form: "astralcodexten", "astralcodexten.substack.com", or a custom domain like "https://www.bigtechnology.com". Custom domains and redirects are handled automatically.

postUrls.title: Individual post URLs
postUrls.description: Scrape specific posts instead of (or in addition to) whole publications, e.g. https://www.bigtechnology.com/p/some-post.

discoverCategories.title: Discover by category (no URLs needed)
discoverCategories.description: Start from a topic instead of a URL list: Substack category slugs (e.g. technology, business, finance, culture, us-politics, food). Publications come back in Substack leaderboard order and are scraped like any other publication. Subcategory slugs work too. Combine with maxPublicationsPerCategory.

maxPublicationsPerCategory.title: Max publications per category
maxPublicationsPerCategory.description: How many top publications to take from each category in discoverCategories.

discoverType.title: Discovery: newsletters or podcasts
discoverType.description: Filter discovered publications by type. Only applies to discoverCategories.

searchQuery.title: Search within the publication
searchQuery.description: Only return posts matching this keyword inside each publication's archive. Leave empty to get the newest posts.

includeBodyText.title: Include full article text
includeBodyText.description: Fetch each post's full body and return it as clean plain text. Costs one extra request per post; free posts return the whole article, paywalled posts return the public preview.

includeBodyHtml.title: Include raw HTML body
includeBodyHtml.description: Also return the original body_html (large; useful if you want to keep formatting, images and links).

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: Also return each post's comments (whole thread, flattened, with parent IDs). Comments are charged as results like posts.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Cap on comments returned per post.

includePublicationInfo.title: Include publication info
includePublicationInfo.description: Add publication-level fields to every post row: free subscriber count, paid-subscriber band, bestseller tier, author name/handle/bio, subscription plan prices, podcast flag, language and first-post date. Costs one extra request per publication (cached), not per post.

contentType.title: Content type
contentType.description: Filter posts by type: regular newsletter posts, podcast episodes, or threads (Substack Notes-style discussion posts).

audienceFilter.title: Free / paid posts
audienceFilter.description: Return all posts, only free (public) posts, or only paywalled subscriber posts.

publishedAfter.title: Published after (ISO date)
publishedAfter.description: e.g. 2026-01-01. Posts older than this are skipped.

publishedBefore.title: Published before (ISO date)
publishedBefore.description: e.g. 2026-09-01. Posts newer than this are skipped.

maxPostsPerPublication.title: Max posts per publication
maxPostsPerPublication.description: How deep to go into each publication's archive. This counts posts SCANNED, before audienceFilter/publishedAfter/publishedBefore are applied — so when you use those filters (or searchQuery, which returns matches in relevance order, not date order), raise this well above the number of results you want, or matching posts deeper in the archive are never looked at.

maxResults.title: Max results (total)
maxResults.description: Overall cap across all publications, posts and comments. This is what you pay for.
